validation.independence: Same independent auditor session as round 1 (2728570e45a1, anthropic/claude-opus-5-5), separate from translator session 073cc3536c59. All values were read from the catalogue bytes; no translator summary was relied on.
validation.semantics: English diff 359a2f55ec..2fb94727d3 touches only en settings/context and keys.gen.ts. The 84 non-hold en and context values are byte-identical to round 1, and only hold.chief_of_staff_unlinked is new. Remediation: consent.changed, local.stays_enrolled, allowed_heading, blocked_heading and listed_only match the round-1 proposals, and cue_listed_only quotes the new listed_only label exactly. consent.via_dialog took an alternative, «Окно согласия» ('consent window'), instead of the proposed «Вводное окно». It is accepted: accurate for the one-time Agent messages consent dialog, no collision with the onboarding wizard's «Первоначальная настройка», and shorter than the English. Hold keys: «координатор» matches the onboarding term (ui.onboarding.extras.greeting_*), and «на боковой панели» matches the ru sidebar term (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.*). Both notices make sending one message the condition («Чтобы получить его/их, отправьте одно сообщение…»), so opening alone is not implied to release anything. Nothing reads as refused, failed, read or lost («ждёт/ждут» is calm news). hold.open «Написать координатору» is an infinitive verb label, 'write to the coordinator', and does not imply it sends anything.
validation.icu: All 87 en and ru values parse with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser (run from the auditor scratchpad via NODE_PATH). The hold arms are one/few/many/other, matching Intl.PluralRules('ru') categories [one, few, many, other]; {count} is preserved in every arm. intl-messageformat output: 1 → «1 сообщение ждёт … получить его»; 2 → «2 сообщения ждут … их»; 5 → «5 сообщений ждут … их»; 21 → «21 сообщение ждёт … его»; 1000000 → «1000000 сообщений ждут … их». Noun case, verb number and pronoun agree in every arm, for both hold keys.
validation.typography: UTF-8, no BOM, no CR, trailing newline, tab indentation, NFC, no Cf/bidi controls or NBSP. Changed values contain no straight quotes, triple dots or spaced hyphens. Key set and order equal en (87/87).
